events.did: came straight to the Command room in dirty, dented field gear to demand that Eli be put down, 60 minutes before the end
events.quote_anchor: “YOU have to put him down,” said Noah.

events.did: said that Eli shot him in the chest and blatantly disregarded orders
events.quote_anchor: “Eli shot me in the chest. He blatantly disregarded orders.”

events.did: asked Noah whether putting Eli down was an order
events.quote_anchor: Gabriel felt the faint tug of defiance, and he had neither the time nor the inclination to indulge it. “Is that an order, Agent Harris?” he asked, arching a brow.

events.did: laid his palm against the sensor and the door slid open onto a barren steel cell
events.quote_anchor: The door slid open onto a barren steel cell. No cot, no sink, nothing but reinforced concrete and metal posts.

events.did: told Eli that the room is not for his current patients but for those who haven't started treatment yet
events.quote_anchor: “It doesn’t,” said Gabriel, unbuttoning his cuffs. “This room isn’t for my current patients. It’s for those who haven’t started treatment yet.”

events.did: held out his belt and ordered Eli to bind his hands to the post in the corner of the room
events.quote_anchor: Gabriel held out the belt. “Take this,” he said, and the look on Eli’s face was a mix of fury, hatred, and betrayal.

events.did: looped the belt around the metal post and then around his own wrists
events.quote_anchor: He looped the belt around it, and then around his wrists.

events.did: said “I forgive you” and untied the knot he had made Eli tie
events.quote_anchor: “I forgive you,” he said, untying the knot.

relations.did: acted as Gabriel's loyal soldier, his fury aimed at Gabriel on his behalf
relations.quote_anchor: Noah’s fury wasn’t directed at Gabriel, but on his behalf. Ever the loyal soldier. And perhaps he had a point.

relations.did: resisted Gabriel's will, and could still prove an asset only if he was broken and made to heel
relations.quote_anchor: He could still prove an asset, if he could be broken, made to heel.

relations.did: resurrected EOs in this room, bringing them back after they had been killed
relations.quote_anchor: A place EOs were brought after they’d been killed, and before Gabriel resurrected them.

relations.did: exempted his resistance to authority only where God was concerned, his devotion built on fear as much as faith
relations.quote_anchor: But his devotion to that higher power was built on fear as much as faith.

numbers.did: the other four agents in Command were present, together with Helena and Malcolm
numbers.quote_anchor: In front of Helena, and Malcolm, and the other four agents in Command. Not that any of them seemed to notice. Still.

numbers.did: his resistance to authority had one exception: God
numbers.quote_anchor: As he spoke, Gabriel’s fingers went to the buckle on his thin black belt. Eli’s resistance to authority had one exception. God.

numbers.did: his fingers slipped more than once while tying the belt, so he had to use his teeth to cinch the knot around his wrists
numbers.quote_anchor: More than once, his fingers slipped while he was doing it, and in the end, he had to use his teeth to cinch the knot around his wrists.
